verification_questions.question: pg_dump child process uzun calisirsa (ornegin 2 saat) NSSM shutdown / IIS recycle durumunda nasil sonlandiriliyor? DisableConcurrentExecution timeout'u kafi mi, yoksa Process.Kill ile explicit cleanup var mi?

Postgres credential'lari (conn string'den parse edilen sifre) pg_dump'a nasil iletiliyor? Komut satirinda password gecerken process listesinde (Get-Process / Task Manager) sizma riski var mi? PGPASSWORD env var veya .pgpass pattern kullanilmis mi?
Disk guard once dump yazdiktan sonra mi, once mi calisir? Dolu disk senaryosunda kismi (corrupt) dump kalir mi ve silme logic'i bunu temizler mi?

Retention delete loop'u, ayni gun icinde olusturulan yeni dump'i (henuz yazimi bitmemis) silme riski tasir mi? mtime cutoff 14 gun oldugu icin guvenli kabul ediliyor mu, yoksa 'currently-being-written' dosya icin ek filtre gerekir mi?

try_catch_locations: DbBackupJob.RunAsync — top-level try/catch(OperationCanceledException) pattern (TranslationCleanupJob paralleli). Diger exception'lar Hangfire AutomaticRetry + INV-JOB-005 finalize path'ine akar.
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Her failure path'i explicit log eder: pg_dump exit != 0 -> INV-JOB-010, disk < threshold -> INV-JOB-011, pg_dump.exe yok -> INV-JOB-012. Exception bubble olursa Hangfire retry + INV-JOB-005 devreye girer. Dashboard job durumu gorunur.

verdict.raw_text:
OVERALL_VERDICT: PASS
BLOCKING_ISSUES: NONE
SUMMARY: Review evidence supports that the iteration fixed the prior typed-catch compliance issue without introducing scope creep or new reliability regressions. The backup job uses explicit typed catches, actionable error-code logging, explicit child-process cleanup, and pre-flight disk checks consistent with the stated plan.

CQ1.evidence: Actionable operator-facing skip/failure logs with INV-JOB codes + Next step hints

CQ2.evidence: No silent failures; all helpers log before return; cancellation path kills + deletes partial file

CQ4.evidence: 4 Log* helper methods centralize repeated catch-body logging

CQ5.evidence: Explicit typed catch blocks only (IOException, UnauthorizedAccessException, ArgumentException, InvalidOperationException, Win32Exception, NotSupportedException) - zero bare catch(Exception)

CQ6.evidence: Single directory enumeration, using-scoped Process + CancellationTokenSource, no N+1

CQ8.evidence: Additive Shared constants only, no contract changes

CQ9.evidence: Backend-local ops job; cluster-level exemption documented

CQ10.evidence: No UI change; Hangfire dashboard visibility

CQ11.evidence: No SQL/schema changes; uses existing conn string

Q1.reasoning: Linked CTS timeout + explicit TryKill(entireProcessTree:true) + TryDelete partial on cancellation; DisableConcurrentExecution only prevents overlap

Q2.reasoning: PGPASSWORD env var + --no-password; password never on command line

Q3.reasoning: Pre-flight HasEnoughFreeDisk before pg_dump start; TryDelete on both cancel and exit!=0 paths; fail-closed disk guard

Q4.reasoning: DeleteExpiredDumps runs after successful completion; mtime cutoff 14 days excludes same-day file
